data.title: Agile sprint flow with agent input
data.phase: active · SKILL.md + sprint.html shipped; agent-proposed sprint flow pending
data.summary: Sprint planning today is semi-manual: sprints[] live in state/<project>/index.json and are edited by agents or humans via the Persist/POST contract. Goal: agents PROPOSE sprint compositions based on plan ROI/effort/blockers/milestone; humans accept/override via the sprint.html Lock button. The proposal + acceptance flow is designed; first agent-generated sprint remains pending.

sections.body: sprints[] in state/<project>/index.json carries id, theme, starts, ends, status, items[] (slugs with justification, tier, done_when). The reckon SPA (v7-shell.jsx) surfaces the active sprint as a kanban preview on the project view; the sprint tab shows the full board with a sprint switcher (pill tabs) and a LockBanner for planned sprints. Sprint composition is written via the Persist/POST contract — agents use /reckon-edit to propose and the human clicks Lock to activate.

New verb: /reckon-edit sprint propose [N]. Agent reads inventory + per-plan ROI/effort/blockers/milestone + last activity from state/<project>/index.json. Builds a candidate sprint with proposed_by:'agent/opus' and per-item justification[] (one line per item). Writes to sprints[] with status:'planned'. The reckon SPA renders planned sprints distinctly, with a LockBanner and a 'Lock' button that flips status to 'active' and writes back via POST.

Once a sprint is active, humans can use /reckon-edit sprint move <slug> <to-sprint> to relocate items. Each move appends to overrides[] with timestamp + reason. The sprint view shows agent justification as a tooltip on each item and visually distinguishes human-moved items. The weekly cadence is implemented via the /schedule skill + Claude API batch (decision: sprint-proposal-cadence).

sprint-proposal-cadence.rationale: implement with the claude api - this would be a great use of a weekly task

agent-rationale-location.rationale: per-item scoping, renamed why_now → justification at implementation time (see coordinator note n-coord-1)

proposal-acceptance-ux.rationale: we should be able to select sprints / switch between them. the agents should have access (easy access) to this sprint data

notes.body: Recommendation on agent-rationale-location (still open): keep per-item, but RENAME the field from `why_now` to `justification`. `why_now` is fragile (a question); `justification` is a stronger noun and matches the agile vocabulary. Per-item scoping is what you asked for. Rename landed with the sprint.html redesign on 2026-05-21.

followups.title: Resolve the three decisions on this plan; then update reckon-edit SKILL.md
followups.body: Once cadence, rationale-location, and acceptance-UX are locked, update ~/.claude/skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md and add Lock button to sprint tab in v7-shell.jsx. Update state/<project>/index.json schema to carry the new sprint fields.

Plan:    plans-agile-sprints
Section: §1–§3 (after the three §-decisions are locked)
Tier:    opus

  acceptance UX must be locked first via inline-decision clicks on this page.
  Once locked, this followup is unblocked.

followups.outcome: All three decisions locked. Sprint.html redesigned with sprint switcher (pill tabs), LockBanner for planned sprints, per-item justification in KCard. plan.html bug fixed. Both dotfiles canonical and imas-ambix copies updated. Commits: f4d39ff (dotfiles), 58b4aba + f31b69c (imas-ambix). reckon-edit SKILL.md update pending as reckon-edit supersedes plan-sprint.

followups.title: Run /reckon-edit sprint propose to author the first agent-generated sprint
followups.body: The infrastructure is now in place (v7-shell.jsx sprint tab + reckon-edit SKILL.md). Next: run /reckon-edit sprint propose to generate the first agent-authored sprint allocation for imas-ambix. The proposal should use the locked decisions — weekly cadence, per-item justification, Lock button activation. Also: set up the weekly Claude API cron job so future proposals run automatically.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix
Plan:    plans-agile-sprints (docs/state/reckon/plans-agile-sprints.json)
Section: first sprint proposal + cron setup
Tier:    sonnet

Context
  The agent-proposed sprint infrastructure just landed: v7-shell.jsx has a
  sprint switcher and Lock button; reckon-edit SKILL.md is updated with
  cadence (weekly), justification field, and Lock button UX.
  This followup generates the first actual sprint proposal for imas-ambix.

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/index.json        (inventory + current sprints)
  docs/state/reckon/plans-agile-sprints.json

Locked decisions to honour
  sprint-proposal-cadence    → scheduled (weekly), via Claude API cron
  agent-rationale-location   → sprint.items[].justification (renamed from why_now)
  proposal-acceptance-ux     → Lock button on sprint tab

Open decisions to surface
  (none — all locked)

Constraints
  - Items in the proposed sprint must be objects: {slug, justification, tier, done_when}
  - Do not activate the sprint — write it as status:'planned' and let the human click Lock
  - Use /reckon-edit sprint propose verb from the SKILL.md
  - After proposing, set up the weekly Claude API cron job (see /schedule skill)

Done-when
  1. A new planned sprint entry in docs/state/imas-ambix/index.json with object items[]
  2. Each item has a non-empty justification field
  3. This followup resolved with outcome
  4. Weekly cron job registered (or deferred with a note if not yet possible)
